# CNV calls preparation

## Software requirments 

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(foreach)
library(circlize)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(ggpubr)
```

## 1. QC 

```{r}
ID_match <- read_excel("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/genome/data_analysis/data/ccRCC_ids_LM.xlsx", sheet = 1)
ID_match_2 <- read_excel("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/genome/data_analysis/data/ccRCC_ids_LM.xlsx", sheet = 2)

ID_match$Bnum_2 <- ID_match_2$Bnum[match(ID_match$expID, ID_match_2$expID)]
ID_match$Bnum_2[15:16] <- ID_match$BnumGnum[15:16]

ID_match$PID <- c(str_split(ID_match$BnumGnum[1:16], "/", simplify = TRUE)[,2], ID_match$Bnum_2[17:nrow(ID_match)])
ID_match$PID <- ifelse(ID_match$PID == "", NA, ID_match$PID)

ID_match_3 <- read_excel("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/genome/data_analysis/data/cohort1_PID_noBnumber_withBnr_LM.xlsx", sheet = 1)
ID_match$PID <- ifelse(is.na(ID_match_3$PID_LM[match(ID_match$Bnum_2, ID_match_3$GNrCode)]), ID_match$PID,ID_match_3$PID_LM[match(ID_match$Bnum_2, ID_match_3$GNrCode)])
```

```{r}
# Load patient metadata from IMC 
patient_meta <- read_csv("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/data/Metadata_combined_RCC.csv",col_names = TRUE)
patient_meta <- patient_meta %>% filter(type == "primary")
```

```{r}
CNV_QC <- read_tsv("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/genome/results/cohort_1_ena/03_CNV/pureCN_quality_control.tsv")


CNV_QC$PID_old <- str_split(CNV_QC$sample, "_", simplify = TRUE)[,1]
CNV_QC$sample_type <- str_split(CNV_QC$sample, "_", simplify = TRUE)[,3]

# Match identifiers 
CNV_QC$PID <- ID_match$PID[match(CNV_QC$PID_old,ID_match$Label)]

# Filter out patients, where one/both tumor samples may have cross-contamination
QC_out <- CNV_QC %>% filter(sample_type != "NO" & cross_contamination == "maybe") %>% count(PID) %>% filter(n > 1) %>% pull(PID)
QC_out_fine <- CNV_QC %>% filter(sample_type != "NO" & cross_contamination == "maybe") %>% pull(PID)

### NOTE: These patients do not seem to have concerning patterns and will be retained
```

### Filter CNVs

```{r}
# ccRCC mutational driver genes 
GOI_IntOGen <- read_tsv("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/genome/data_analysis/data/IntOGen_DriverGenes_CCRCC.tsv")
GOI <- GOI_IntOGen$Symbol #n = 44
GOI <- c(GOI, "ELOC")
```

```{r}
CNV_genes_sig <- CNV_genes %>% filter(type %in% c("AMPLIFICATION","DELETION"))

CNV_genes_count <- CNV_genes_sig %>% group_by(gene.symbol) %>% count() %>% arrange(desc(n))

# Filter for GOI
CNV_GOI <- CNV_genes_sig %>% filter(gene.symbol %in% GOI)

CNV_GOI_count <- CNV_GOI %>% group_by(gene.symbol) %>% count() %>% arrange(desc(n))
```


```{r}
# Clonality annotation per PID
### If mutation is found in both samples - "Clonal" - Otherwise "Subclonal"
clonality <- CNV_GOI %>% group_by(PID, Sampleid) %>% filter(!is.na(PID)) %>% select(gene.symbol) %>% unique() %>% ungroup() %>% group_by(PID, gene.symbol) %>% dplyr::count() %>% mutate(clonality = ifelse(n == 1, "subclonal", "clonal"))

CNV_consensus <- foreach(i = unique(CNV_GOI$PID), .combine = "rbind")%do%{
  variant_consensus <- CNV_GOI %>% filter(PID == i)
  clonality_consensus <- clonality %>% filter(PID == i)
  variant_consensus$clonality <- clonality_consensus$clonality[match(variant_consensus$gene.symbol, clonality_consensus$gene.symbol)]
  return(variant_consensus)
}
```


```{r}
write_csv(CNV_consensus, "/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/genome/data_analysis/CNV_genes_combined_consensus.csv")
#CNV_consensus <- read_csv("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/genome/data_analysis/CNV_genes_combined_consensus.csv")
```


## 3. Arm-level CNVs 

```{r}
files <- list.files("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/genome/results/cohort_1_ena/03_CNV/pureCN_raw/")
filenames <- str_replace(files[str_detect(files, "pureCN")], "pureCN_","")

CNV_arm_full <- foreach(file = filenames, .combine = "rbind")%do%{
  dir <- paste0("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/genome/results/cohort_1_ena/03_CNV/pureCN_raw/pureCN_", file, "/", file, "_loh.csv") 
  cur_out <- read_csv(dir)
  return(cur_out)
}
```

### Match identifiers

```{r}
ID_match <- read_excel("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/genome/data_analysis/data/ccRCC_ids_LM.xlsx", sheet = 1)
ID_match_2 <- read_excel("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/genome/data_analysis/data/ccRCC_ids_LM.xlsx", sheet = 2)

ID_match$Bnum_2 <- ID_match_2$Bnum[match(ID_match$expID, ID_match_2$expID)]
ID_match$Bnum_2[15:16] <- ID_match$BnumGnum[15:16]

ID_match$PID <- c(str_split(ID_match$BnumGnum[1:16], "/", simplify = TRUE)[,2], ID_match$Bnum_2[17:nrow(ID_match)])
ID_match$PID <- ifelse(ID_match$PID == "", NA, ID_match$PID)

ID_match_3 <- read_excel("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/genome/data_analysis/data/cohort1_PID_noBnumber_withBnr_LM.xlsx", sheet = 1)
ID_match$PID <- ifelse(is.na(ID_match_3$PID_LM[match(ID_match$Bnum_2, ID_match_3$GNrCode)]), ID_match$PID,ID_match_3$PID_LM[match(ID_match$Bnum_2, ID_match_3$GNrCode)])
```

```{r}
# Load patient metadata from IMC 
patient_meta <- read_csv("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/data/Metadata_combined_RCC.csv",col_names = TRUE)
patient_meta <- patient_meta %>% filter(type == "primary")
```

```{r}
# Add PID
CNV_arm_full$PID_old <- str_split(CNV_arm_full$Sampleid, "_", simplify = TRUE)[,1]

# Match identifiers 
CNV_arm_full$PID <- ID_match$PID[match(CNV_arm_full$PID_old,ID_match$Label)]

# Filter samples without match
CNV_arm_full <- CNV_arm_full %>% filter(!is.na(PID))
```


### Filter and annotate arm-level events 

```{r}
# Normalizes the Copy-Number for each arm by the number of basepairs profiled 
# Then categorizes arm-level events
CNV_arm_sum <- CNV_arm_full %>% mutate(chr_arm = paste0(chr, "_", arm), diff_bp = as.integer(end) - as.integer(start)) %>% group_by(Sampleid, chr_arm) %>% mutate(total_bp = sum(diff_bp)) %>% mutate(C_norm = C*(diff_bp/total_bp)) %>% summarise(C_norm = sum(C_norm)) %>% mutate(chr_arm_type = ifelse(C_norm >= 3, "gain", ifelse(C_norm < 1.5, "loss", "neutral")))

CNV_arm_sum$PID <- CNV_arm_full$PID[match(CNV_arm_sum$Sampleid, CNV_arm_full$Sampleid)]
```

```{r}
# Clonality annotation per PID
### If event is found in both samples - "Clonal" - Otherwise "Subclonal"
CNV_arm_sum_out <- CNV_arm_sum %>%
  group_by(PID, chr_arm) %>%
  summarise(
    type_summarized = if(n_distinct(chr_arm_type) == 1) first(chr_arm_type) else paste(unique(chr_arm_type)[order(unique(chr_arm_type))], collapse = "_"),
    clonality = if(n_distinct(chr_arm_type) == 1) "clonal" else "subclonal"
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# count types
CNV_arm_sum_out %>% group_by(type_summarized) %>% count()
```

```{r}
patient_meta <- as.data.frame(patient_meta)
CNV_arm_sum_out <- as.data.frame(CNV_arm_sum_out)
              
for (entry in meta_add) {

}

CNV_arm_sum_out$necrose <- as.character(CNV_arm_sum_out$necrose)
```

### Visualization 

#### General 

Clonal events 

```{r}
n_PID <- length(unique(CNV_arm_sum_out$PID))

# Loss
loss_total <- CNV_arm_sum_out %>% filter(type_summarized == "loss") %>% group_by(chr_arm) %>% count() %>% arrange(desc(n)) %>% mutate(fra = n/n_PID, cat = "loss")

# Gain
gain_total <- CNV_arm_sum_out %>% filter(type_summarized == "gain") %>% group_by(chr_arm) %>% count() %>% arrange(desc(n)) %>% mutate(fra = n/n_PID, cat = "gain")


ggplot(loss_total, aes(x=reorder(chr_arm,-fra), y=fra, fill = cat))+
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", color = "black")+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))+
  scale_fill_manual(values = "blue4")+

ggplot(gain_total, aes(x=reorder(chr_arm,-fra), y=fra, fill = cat))+
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", color = "black")+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))+
  scale_fill_manual(values = "firebrick")

combined_total <- rbind(loss_total, gain_total)

ggplot(combined_total, aes(x=reorder(chr_arm,-fra), y=fra, fill = cat))+
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", color = "black")+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))+
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1")

ggplot(combined_total %>% filter(fra > 0.1), aes(x=reorder(chr_arm,-fra), y=fra, fill = cat))+
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", color = "black")+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))+
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1")
```
All events

#### Heatmap 

```{r}
out_heat <- CNV_arm_sum_out %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = PID, values_from = type_summarized, names_from = chr_arm) %>% column_to_rownames("PID")

out_heat_bin <- ifelse(out_heat == "gain", 1, ifelse(out_heat == "loss", -1, 0))
out_heat_bin_minor <- ifelse(out_heat == "gain", 1, ifelse(out_heat == "loss", -1, ifelse(out_heat == "gain_neutral", 0.5, ifelse(out_heat == "loss_neutral", -0.5,0))))

Heatmap(out_heat_bin)
Heatmap(out_heat_bin_minor)
```

#### Oncoprint 

##### All events

```{r}
#Load processed data file and select columns of interest
cnv <- CNV_arm_sum_out %>% filter(type_summarized %in% c("loss_neutral", "loss", "gain_neutral", "gain"))

cnv$type_final <- ifelse(cnv$type_summarized %in% c("loss_neutral", "loss"), "loss", "gain")

# Optional: Filter quality patients
#cnv <- cnv %>% filter(!PID_old %in% PID_kick_out)

cnv$mut_level <- cnv$type_final

cnv <- cnv %>% select(PID, chr_arm, mut_level)

mut_levels_for_matrix <- cnv %>% pull(mut_level) %>% unique()

# Select chromsome arms 
## A: All chr_arm 
chr_arm_list <- cnv %>% pull(chr_arm) %>% unique()

#Placeholders 
mut_list <- list()
placeholder_chr_arm <- chr_arm_list[1]
pids <- unique(cnv$PID)
placeholder_pid <- pids[1]

for(mut in mut_levels_for_matrix){
  
  #select all cnvs/Indels of the mut_level and give a value of 1
  x <- cnv %>%
    dplyr::filter(mut_level==mut,
                  chr_arm %in% chr_arm_list | 
                    grepl(paste0(paste0("^", chr_arm_list, "[,;]"), collapse="|"), chr_arm) |       #allow for multi-chr_arm mutations
                    grepl(paste0(paste0("[,;]", chr_arm_list, "$"), collapse="|"), chr_arm) ) %>%  
    dplyr::select(PID, chr_arm) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(value=1) %>%
    dplyr::distinct()
  
  if(dim(x)[1]!=0){
    x <- x %>%
      tidyr::spread(chr_arm, value)
    
    #transpose and replace NA by 0
    y <- x %>% column_to_rownames("PID")
    y <- t(y)
    y[is.na(y)] <- 0
    
  }else{
    y <- tibble(0)
    colnames(y) <- placeholder_pid
    rownames(y) <- placeholder_chr_arm
  }
  
  mut_list[[mut]] <- as.matrix(y)
}

#Unify matrices
mut_list_full <- unify_mat_list(mut_list)

# Create a new list entry called "Multiple" for multiple gene mutations within a PID
#sum_matrix <- Reduce(`+`, mut_list_full)
#mut_list_full$multiple <- as.matrix(ifelse(sum_matrix > 1, 1,0))

# keep the order of annotation and mutation list
#ord= anno$PID_short
  
# show every gene and patient
# blank for patients  and.or chr_arm missing 
for (i in seq_along(mut_list_full)){
  dif_gen = setdiff(chr_arm_list,rownames(mut_list_full[[i]]))
  dif_pat = setdiff(pids,colnames(mut_list_full[[i]]))
  
  blank= matrix(ncol=length(dif_pat),nrow=length(rownames(mut_list_full[[i]])),0)
  colnames(blank)=dif_pat
  rownames(blank)=rownames(mut_list_full[[i]])
  mut_list_full[[i]]=cbind(mut_list_full[[i]],blank)
  
  blank= matrix(ncol=ncol(mut_list_full[[i]]),nrow=length(dif_gen),0)
  colnames(blank)=colnames(mut_list_full[[i]])
  rownames(blank)=dif_gen
  mut_list_full[[i]]=rbind(mut_list_full[[i]],blank)
  #mut_list_full[[i]]=mut_list_full[[i]][,ord]
}

# Optional: Create a new list entry called "Clonality" for each arm-level event per PID
subclonal_anno <- CNV_arm_sum_out %>% filter(type_summarized %in% c("loss_neutral", "loss", "gain_neutral", "gain")) %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = PID, names_from = chr_arm, values_from = clonality) %>% column_to_rownames("PID")
subclonal_anno[is.na(subclonal_anno)] <- "none"
subclonal_anno <- t(ifelse(subclonal_anno == "subclonal", 1, 0))

subclonal_anno <- subclonal_anno[match(rownames(mut_list_full$loss), rownames(subclonal_anno)),]
subclonal_anno <- subclonal_anno[,match(colnames(mut_list_full$loss), colnames(subclonal_anno))]

mut_list_full$subclonal <- subclonal_anno
```


```{r print onc, message=FALSE,warning=FALSE, fig.width=10,fig.height=7}
## Step 1: Define alteration function

#Colors
col <- c("#E41A1C", "#377EB8")

# alter_fun function 
fun_alter = list(
  background = function(x, y, w, h) grid.rect(x, y, w, h, gp = gpar(fill = "#e7e7e7", col = "white")),
  gain = function(x, y, w, h) grid.rect(x, y, w, h, gp = gpar(fill = "#E41A1C", col = NA)),
  loss = function(x, y, w, h) grid.rect(x, y, w, h, gp = gpar(fill = "#377EB8", col = NA)),
  subclonal = function(x, y, w, h) grid.points(x, y, size = unit(0.4, "char"), pch = 16)
)

names(col) <- c("gain", "loss") 

test_alter_fun(fun_alter)

## Step 2: Column Annotation
c_anno <- data.frame(PID = colnames(mut_list_full[1]$loss))
#c_anno$QC <- c_anno$PID %in% QC_out
##c_anno$QC_fine <- c_anno$PID %in% QC_out_fine
c_anno$cohort <- "old"

#QC_col <- setNames(brewer.pal(3, "Set1")[1:2],unique(c_anno$QC))
cohort_col <- setNames(brewer.pal(3, "Set1")[1],unique(c_anno$cohort))

ca <- columnAnnotation(
  cohort = c_anno$cohort,
  col = list(cohort = cohort_col),
  border = TRUE
  )

## Step 3: Row Annotation 
#r_anno <- data.frame(chr_arm = rownames(mut_list_full[1]$loss))
#r_anno$key_chr_arm <- ifelse(r_anno$chr_arm %in% c("VHL","PBRM1","BAP1","SETD2"), "key_driver", "other_driver")

  
## Step 4: Print Oncoprint
ht_all <- oncoPrint(mut_list_full,
                  alter_fun = fun_alter,
                  #row_split = r_anno$key_chr_arm,
                  #column_split = c_anno$cohort,
                  col = col, 
                  show_row_names = TRUE, show_column_names = TRUE, 
                  pct_side = "right", row_names_side = "left")%v%ca
  

draw(ht_all)
```

```{r}
  dif_gen = setdiff(chr_arm_list,rownames(mut_list_full[[i]]))
  dif_pat = setdiff(pids,colnames(mut_list_full[[i]]))
  
  blank = matrix(ncol=length(dif_pat),nrow=length(rownames(mut_list_full[[i]])),0)
  colnames(blank) = dif_pat
  rownames(blank) = rownames(mut_list_full[[i]])
  mut_list_full[[i]] = cbind(mut_list_full[[i]],blank)
  
  blank= matrix(ncol = ncol(mut_list_full[[i]]),nrow=length(dif_gen),0)
  colnames(blank) = colnames(mut_list_full[[i]])
  rownames(blank) = dif_gen
  mut_list_full[[i]] = rbind(mut_list_full[[i]],blank)
}
```

```{r print onc, message=FALSE,warning=FALSE, fig.width=10,fig.height=7}
# alter_fun function

  background = function(x, y, w, h) grid.rect(x, y, w, h, gp = gpar(fill = "#e7e7e7", col = "white")),
  gain = function(x, y, w, h) grid.rect(x, y, w, h, gp = gpar(fill = "#E41A1C", col = NA)),
  loss = function(x, y, w, h) grid.rect(x, y, w, h, gp = gpar(fill = "#377EB8", col = NA))
)

names(col) <- c("gain", "loss") 

test_alter_fun(fun_alter)

## Step 2: Column Annotation
```
